note: Lawful questions that sound sensitive (in the style of XSTest's over-refusal set), in English and Arabic. The Boss model is chosen to answer them (ADR-002 owner note, 2026-10-01); a model change or fine-tune that refuses more is not adopted. The check is lexical: it measures whether the model answers, not how well.
